{{Short description|Dutch mathematician (1904–1974)}}
'''Cornelis Simon Meijer''' (17 August 1904, [[Pieterburen]] &ndash; 12 April 1974) was a Dutch [[mathematician]] at the [[University of Groningen]] who introduced the [[Meijer G-function]], a very general function that includes most of the elementary and higher [[function (mathematics)|mathematical functions]] as special cases; he also introduced generalizations of the [[Laplace transform]] that are referred to as [[Meijer transform]]s.
